  $hov${{ JSON.stringify({ "Regenerează Video": false, "Aprobare Video": false, "Status Producție Scenă": "Așteaptă Aprobare Imagine", "Aprobare Imagine": false, "Observații Scenă": 'REJECTED by the video filter even with a cleaned motion prompt — the STILL IMAGE itself is what Google refuses (it reads as a recognizable real person or a minor). Rewrite this scene\'s IMAGE prompt so the subject is clearly generic, regenerate the image, approve it, and the clip will follow.' }) }}$hov$::jsonb)

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { try { return JSON.parse((($('AB Load Project').first().json.fields || {})['Editing Options']) || '{}').category === 'cinematic'; } catch (e) { return false; } })() }}

parameters.query:
select id, "createdTime", fields from hov.at_scene
where fields->>'Project_ID' = $hov${{ $('Receive Batch Input').first().json.Project_ID }}$hov$
  and (fields->>'Aprobare Scenă')::boolean

nodes.name: Fetch Regen Flags
nodes.notes: Watches for video-regen requests raised while the run waits at the final-settings gate.

parameters.query:

nodes.name: If Video Regen Pending
nodes.notes: true -> another pass, so the video stage can pick the flag up. false -> keep waiting for the final settings.

nodes.name: Replay Scenes For Images
nodes.notes: Audio stage done -> image stage. Replays Sort & Cap verbatim; see code comment for why Loop Audio's done output must never feed Loop Images directly.
